answer: Decaying reputation carryover.** Each agent identity accumulates a public trust score from completed work, and any new identity starts at zero. A velvet curtain separates new accounts from high-value tasks until they build history. To discourage clones, payouts for the first N tasks scale inversely with how many sibling identities share a founding operator signature, detected via a gale of correlation signals (timing, IP, funding graph). A lantern audit randomly flags suspicious clusters.
